summary: Workers/D1 adapter for the model gateway data plane (#347, streaming #348): gateway-core GatewayPorts over D1 and createGatewayApp mounted at /gateway/v1/* by routes/gateway.ts, which passes ctx.waitUntil so a disconnected stream still settles. Guide: apps/docs/guide/gateway-data-plane.md.
context_hints: Decisions (routing, settlement, pricing, coded errors, the HTTP flow) live in @clash/gateway-core; these files only make them durable. Never re-implement them here.
D1 columns are unix seconds, gateway-core is epoch ms: convert through d1-common.ts only.
Identity is the sk_gw_ token (services/gateway-tokens.ts) with the models:invoke scope; no header, x-user-id included, is identity.

Official upstream secrets: secret_ref may only name a GATEWAY_UPSTREAM_* Worker secret or Secrets Store binding; envelopes are sealed under GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY, which must differ from ACTION_SECRET_KEY (tenant BYOK) or sealed keys fail closed. No key material in errors, logs, audit or the ledger; views show a short keyPrefix only.
Unimplemented ports (scheduler, audit) are unavailablePort (501), never silent no-ops.

Abuse (#356): the data plane counts requests/401s per minute (gateway_abuse_observation, fingerprint hashed from cf-connecting-ip + user agent) and refuses suspended tenants/keys with GATEWAY_SUSPENDED; thresholds are evaluated by the scheduled handler (evaluateGatewayAbuseNow).

Body retention (#353, decision 2026-10-20): blobs = R2 (R2_BUCKET, prefix gateway-retention/), retention = D1 gateway_request_retention metadata only. On only when GATEWAY_STAFF_PROMPT_ACCESS=enabled (hosted); purge runs regardless from the scheduled handler. Never store headers or upstream credentials. Streams are retained as delivered, capped; a cut copy is response_truncated = 1 (0039).

Settlement (#399, N2): follow-up charges and refunds are Durable Runs of owner api-cf:gateway-settle (settle-runs.ts) on cloud_durable_run_journal + GENERATION_WORKFLOW + the minute cron (generation/recovery.ts iterates every owner). There is no hold sweeper, no settle_failed and no reconcile job; GATEWAY_CREDIT_FLOOR (index.ts) is the text floor knob.

key_files.index.ts: createD1GatewayPorts (settlement over the Workflow binding when given), GATEWAY_CREDIT_FLOOR, workerSecrets, staffPromptAccessEnabled, createCloudflareGatewayApp (basePath /gateway, credit floor, retention per the flag).
key_files.r2-blobs.ts: gateway-core blobs over the R2 bucket; failures are GATEWAY_INTERNAL.
key_files.d1-retention.ts: gateway-core retention over gateway_request_retention (0037, truncation columns 0039); gatewayRetentionPorts and purgeGatewayRetention for the scheduled handler and the admin purge route. enforceGatewayDataRetention (#355): 30-day metadata NULL/delete and 13-month ledger/report/run/audit delete in one bounded D1 batch; live holds untouched; audit cutoff bounded by the DB clock (0036 trigger).
key_files.d1-routes.ts: Published catalog from gateway_model.card_json (live, or one named published version for route pins), official accounts from gateway_upstream_account (tenant scope: none), price book from published gateway_price rows effective at the admission instant (newest version first, exact upstream over model-wide).
key_files.d1-price-book.ts: #352 price-book admin: list, draft (replaced wholly in one batch), publish (one UPDATE; effective_from never before the publish instant). Published rows are immutable; every mutation writes gateway_admin_audit in the same batch.
key_files.d1-billing.ts: #352 credit billing, the D1 adapter of gateway-core's GatewayBillingPort (#425): packages, top-up packs, subscribe (first-period grant), top-up, cancel, idempotent rollover (expire unused grant + next grant), refund, wallet summary. Each operation is one changes()-chained batch with a CHECK-violation guard; ledger request ids are the idempotency anchors.
key_files.d1-billing.test.ts: Price book + billing on node:sqlite: draft/publish, effective dates, no repricing through the real data plane, grant/topup/expire idempotency, team wallet, coded atomic refusals.
key_files.d1-billing.contract.test.ts: gateway-core's shared billing contract (#425) on the D1 adapters; Postgres runs the same suite in apps/api-node.
key_files.d1-credentials.ts: Official credential resolution (secret_ref: Worker secret or Secrets Store binding; or sealed envelope), active version then the draining one (0043) when the active was refused, fail closed with GATEWAY_KEY_UNAVAILABLE; gatewayEncryptionKey (KEK distinct from BYOK), readSecretBinding, sealGatewayUpstreamCredentials.
key_files.d1-upstream-health.ts: #350 gateway-core upstreamHealth over gateway_upstream_health (0043): circuit counters per official account, a failure counted in one upsert (no lost counts), epoch ms columns.
key_files.upstream-keys-migration.test.ts: 0043 on node:sqlite: key_serial carried from in-place rotated versions, draining-version triggers, failure-count CHECK.
key_files.d1-budgets.ts: Hybrid settlement over D1 (#399): check (planCheck, no money write), debit (media prepay, all-or-nothing batch with a CHECK-violation guard), charge (text postpay, never refused) and refund (returns each budget's settle row), each idempotent through the ledger unique (request_id, budget_id, kind); Idempotency-Key claims in gateway_idempotency_claim (0042); hard/soft/alert flags as gateway_budget_event rows in the same batch; ledger reads net of refunds. No budget row = refused, except a tenant-scope (BYOK, #369) request, admitted with no money write.
key_files.d1-limits.ts: rate_limit_json (gateway-core GatewayRateLimitSchema: rpm/tpm/concurrency/mediaJobs) from key / member (tenant_member, 0041) / model / tenant (tightest of subscription and tenant.rate_limit_json), counted in gateway_rate_window and gateway_inflight (0034) under tenant-scoped subjects (tenant:<t>...). Malformed config fails closed.
key_files.d1-common.ts: Time conversion, monotonic clock, published-catalog subquery, JSON helpers, the gwu_ official account id prefix.
key_files.d1-media-jobs.ts: #359 gateway_media_job (0049): one official media job per hosted generation task (ledger request id, frozen GatewayMediaJob, forward-only status planned -> admitted -> settled | refused), and loadGatewayProductIdentity (a product user in a Project's tenant, member required; tenant wallet + member budget).
key_files.d1-admin-audit.ts: #353/#394 the one gateway_admin_audit writer (actor = kind + id: an admin account, or a product user acting through a team role): adminAuditStatement (a statement for the mutation's own batch, chained on changes()) and redactAuditValue (secret keys and credential-shaped values become [redacted]). Rows are append-only (0036 triggers).
key_files.d1-catalog-admin.ts: #353 catalog admin over gateway_model: list (live marked), clone into a draft, #351 seed the AIGC/media-first launch draft (planGatewayLaunchCatalog, one batch + catalog.seed audit), upsert/remove draft models (ModelCardSchema + DeepSeek Flash-only policy), publish (the whole version with the next publish_seq, 0051; then immutable).
key_files.d1-upstream-admin.ts: #353/#350/#351 official upstream accounts: list/create/update/disable, rotate (adds vN+1; the previous version drains, or drain:false revokes it) and revokeKey (ends a drain or rolls back), each one batch with its audit row and a circuit reset. Secrets are write-only (secret_ref name with its fields, or sealed at once); #351 credential fields checked per provider (GATEWAY_UPSTREAM_CREDENTIAL_FIELDS) and DeepSeek Pro/Reasoner refused in supportedModelIds/modelPriorities; views carry kind, field names, key version, keyPrefix, binding presence and circuit health; audit rows carry versions only.
key_files.official-provider.ts: #351 the "Clash official" provider row for /model-providers and /models/catalog: the live published catalog through the D1 routes port (buildOfficialModelProvider), null while unpublished, unavailable + code on failure.
key_files.d1-tenant-admin.ts: #354 team settings store: teams, invites (SHA-256 only, accept by the invited email), member removal (keys revoked) and owner/member roles (last owner kept), member/key budgets with hard/soft/alert enforcement and reasoned overrides, key/member/tenant rate limits, budget events. Each write + audit in one CAS batch.
key_files.d1-admin-accounts.ts: #394 admin accounts (admin_accounts, 0040; never product users): list, create (Better Auth password hash, duplicate email refused; role platform_admin or support_agent, 0046), disable (sessions and password deleted; never the last enabled platform_admin), audited with the admin account as actor.
key_files.admin-account-bootstrap.ts: #394 dependency-free first-admin-account SQL and argument parsing for scripts/gateway-admin-account.ts (local or staging only, idempotent on email; the password is never on argv or printed).
key_files.d1-admin-reads.ts: #353 console reads: audit filter, overview metrics, tenants, live rate-window counters beside the abuse signals.
key_files.d1-abuse.ts: #356 gateway-core abuse port over 0046: per-minute observations (upsert), signals (spend from settle rows), thresholds, alerts (unique per window) and suspensions (one active per subject), each mutation + gateway_admin_audit in one batch (actor system for thresholds); abuseSubjectTenant, readGatewayAbuse (console view), evaluateGatewayAbuseNow (scheduled handler).
key_files.abuse-migration.test.ts: 0046 constraints (one active suspension per subject, auto needs its signal, threshold bounds) and the admin_accounts rebuild for support_agent.
key_files.d1-usage-explorer.ts: #355 usage explorer (guide gateway-usage.md): filtered, cursor-paged ledger entries (one settle per request, lowest budget id) with per-model totals and notCharged, and the same filter as a streamed RFC 4180 CSV (GATEWAY_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE past 100k rows; tenant audience drops upstream_id). Metadata only.
key_files.d1-reconciliation.ts: #355 nightly reconciliation over D1: upstream report import (gateway_upstream_report/_usage, 0052, audited, replace per day+source), ledger vs report per account+model, run + platform adjust rows (ref_kind 'reconcile', direction in status) + audit in one batch, each adjust guarded on the posted sum so concurrent runs never both post. Never touches tenant wallets or settlements (#399).
key_files.scheduled.ts: #355 every-minute cron jobs: metadata/ledger retention at minute 45 hourly, reconciliation at 01:15 UTC; each logged with its code, one failing never stops the other.
key_files.test-support.ts: Test-only seeding, inlineSettleWorkflow (runs settle runs inline; pause loses a first start) and the shared gateway-core contract harness over these ports (node:sqlite unit run and miniflare run).
key_files.d1-gateway.test.ts: Contract on node:sqlite, /gateway/v1 through createApp (spoofed x-user-id ignored, coded 401/402/403/404/502, a stream byte for byte with settlement and retention), settle runs (charge once, unjournaled edge, cron recovery after a lost Workflow start, storage retry, coded refusal), migration 0042 on retired holds, body retention, credential custody.
key_files.settle-runs.ts: #399 Workers wiring of the shared gateway-settle run (gateway-core settle-run.ts: identity, command, executor, retry): owner id api-cf:gateway-settle on cloud_durable_run_journal; createD1GatewaySettlementPort (journal first, Workflow second, recover) and createGatewaySettleCoordinator (the Workflow's executor over the D1 budgets port). api-node wires the same run in src/gateway-settle.ts.
